scope: Fix the October 14 critique findings on Pages 24-29 that the in-place fix pass left open (see critique-fixes-originals-2026-10-14.json, notFixed). Work in place on the original components and screens; archived fixtures were not edited.
approach: Fixes were made at the source: shared components first (Composer content, Mask controls, Cancellation status, Account gate, icon set), then screen-owned layers.

Every write script checked that each node was on the page being edited, that names and current positions or texts matched what was read, and collected all nodes before mutating; previous values are recorded below.
Two scripts failed mid-way (a null nested-instance lookup and a clone parenting assumption); Figma rolled each back completely, which was confirmed by a canvas read before the corrected rerun.
Application code is out of scope; no repository file other than this new record was changed.
